fr_html: L'exercice de toute fonction qui relève de la direction politique, soit nationale, soit internationale, des Etats est incompatible avec la qualité de membre de la Cour.
en_html: The exercise of any function which belongs to the political direction, national or international, of States by the members of the Court during their terms of office, is declared incompatible with their judicial duties.
